title: Keep inventory nerf
description: a datapack to make keep inventory less op
body:
This datapack nerfs the keep_inventory gamerule by damaging armor and tools and taking valuable items on death.

items that can be taken are:
- diamonds
- iron, gold and copper ingots
- raw iron, gold and copper
- emeralds
- experience bottles
- amethyst shards
- iron and gold blocks
- redstone and redstone blocks
- bread
- cookies
- all cooked meat
- baked potatoes
- golden carrots and apples
